note: what gobble 0.4.0 (2e83cce) sent, in two sessions of one capture. The first: an isolated HOME and GOBBLE_HOME whose own settings.yaml set defaultProvider opencode-zen, defaultModel deepseek-v4.1-flash and compaction.keepRecentTokens 1000, with OPENCODE_API_KEY alone; model opencode-zen/deepseek-v4.1-flash set by session/set_config_option, thought_level low; /model and /thinking; a turn reading notes.txt with gobble's read tool; _gobble/set_session_name and _gobble/clone idle, then each refused -32600 mid-turn; a counting turn; three prose turns; /compact (one compaction_update in_progress, then completed with its summary and _meta.gobble reason and tokensBefore); a close, then session/load (the compaction replayed as one completed update, the same id, tokensBefore without reason). The second: no credential at all, which fails before authenticate, so only initialize's answer. No retry occurred, and no permission was asked.
